Paws-itively striking 🧡🖤 The San Diego Zoo and Safari Park care for two of the six tiger subspecies, Malayan and Sumatran. Sumatran tigers, native to the Indonesian island of Sumatra, are the smallest of the subspecies. Their darker coats help them blend into shadows, and longer fur on their faces may help protect them from dense vegetation. Malayan tigers, native to the forests of the Malay Peninsula, have a slightly lighter coat that complements their surroundings. #tiger #sandiegozoo #sdzsafaripark

Be Human Like a Tiger A tiger doesn't roar to prove strength. It moves in silence. It waits, watches, and chooses its moment. Not every battle is worth energy. A tiger walks alone-not because it's lonely, but because it trusts itself. Scars don't make it weaker; they remind it that it survived. When a tiger strikes, it commits fully. No hesitation. No doubt. It doesn't chase approval. The jungle already knows what it is. Life lesson: Move with purpose. Speak less, observe more. Protect your energy. Trust your power.
